(This is similar to the previous response post I made, but I adjusted casualty figures from the hypersonic missiles and removed any mention of Technocratic aircraft directly entering Bob's air space. Beyond that, most things remain the same. Additionally, I added a few more details to account for Bob's most recent RP post.)

[b]Before the Storm[/b]

While the Technocratic forces relied heavily on the element of surprise in the hopes of entrapping the Bob, no amount of counterintelligence or technological superiority, no amount of disparity in resources or swiftness in project enactment, no single quantity in military studies exists that could ever hope to possibly conceal the sheer scale of their rapid and sudden escalation into full-blown war with the Bob. The sheer scale of Reichswehr's force buildupAWACS deployment, large fleet movements, and massive aircraft musteringwould be impossible to hide.

SummitONE Intelligence, together with preexisting Bobian radar intelligence, would be able to easily monitor the sudden sortie of Technocratic naval vessels departing from harbor, while the Bobian Air Force would be very easily forewarned of the looming Technocratic assault thanks to information fed by OTHR and passive ELINT. For all intents and purposes, the Reichswehr's apparent trap against Bobian forces would not be so much a conniving strike rather a completely telegraped jab.

So evident was this looming attack that Bob forces would have no less than a full's day worth of preparation to brace for impact, perhaps more when considering the sheer scale of Technocratic forces building up towards this massive attack. Without a moment's delay, SummitONE Solutions would be appointed to the Bobian military staff for the duration of the conflict, with Freya Moran and her executives effectively installed as dictators over the Bobian territories until further notice.

For this reason, it would be completely impractical for Technocratic forces to successfully intercept most of the Day One deliveries of SummitONE Solutions, with virtually all advisors, contractors, and intelligence equipment arriving without incident. Heavier armaments such as tanks and helicopters, however, would remain at Stormhaven for now.

Concerning the Bobian military inventory, SummitONE would coordinate the rapid dispersal of the Bob's vulnerable air force, which while comparable in technological capabilities to Technocratic equivalents, were nevertheless sorely outnumbered. Sky Sabres and Bloodhounds, which already dot the island's coastline, would also be spread into the cities and across the Republic's military ports in anticipation of a gigantic onslaught, while MANPADs would be quickly distributed to frontline forces for the same reason. EW countermeasures would also be swiftly distributed by SummitONE Technologies across all urban centers, with low Size, Weight & Power (SWAP) jammers littering coastal fortifications in advance of friendly formations.

The Bobian Navy, meanwhile, would act swiftly and send out its mining ships to lay traps all over the narrow strait between itself and the Reichswehr. Anti-ship missile batteries would be moved to mobile installations along hardened silos, disguised shipping containers, and railway-based launchers, while SummitONE Technologies would work overtime installing UUVs to act as acoustic decoys for the enemy.

[b]War of the Western Ocean[/b]

A telegraphed strike is still a strike, and Technocratic forces would hit hard, overriding Bobian radar not through skillful countermasures but through the sheer force of their numbers crashing down into Bobian territory. And yet, there were a multitude of issues that faced the Technocratic forces, not least of which was logistics.

In rapidly scaling their supposed trap from simple provocative fly-bys to blatant encirclements, they would flounder almost utterly in their attempts to prod and poke at the Bobian skies. Without any clear SEAD operations to sweep the Bob of its air defenses, virtually all Technocratic aircraft attempting to engage even at "less saturated air space", with Technocratic BVR systems only maintaining a bare fraction of the effective range of Bobian defenses whether along the Bobian coastline or atop the multitude of Bobian warships lying in wait at harbor.

The British Air Force would not scramble immediately and attempt to dogfight the numerically superior Reichswehr aircraft, instead patiently waiting for their forces to be thinned out naturally.

Of specific casualties, Technocratic forces would find themselves completely unable to use their AMRAAMs and JTAMs in air-to-air engagements, though their air-to-surface anti-radiation missiles would be successful in destroying some Bobian aircraft, with SummitONE counting around two dozen aircraft ranging from multi-role fighters to helicopters damaged or destroyed until the order would be issued to turn off radar systems near grounded aircraft to render these AGM-88 HARM missiles ineffective. HGVs, if any aircraft do manage to survive to be launched, would be highly effective, causing hundreds if not thousands in civilian and military casualties.

The CCAs would pose the biggest threat to Bobian forces. However, these capabilities require extensive AI coordination, bandwidth, and reliable datalink networksnone of which are guaranteed in a contested electronic warfare (EW) environment. Low SWAP jamming systems would be swift to counteract C4ISR networks, targetting CCA coordination systems, AWAC uplinks, and missile guidance signals among other things. Additionally, false radio intelligence and deepfaked communications would flood Technocratic radio signals to disrupt, or at least slow down the pace of their attempted advance.

At sea, Technocratic naval forces would be met and checked by the ferocious Bobian navy. Though, given the gargantuan, almost nonsensical numbers that Technocratic forces were cramming into the narrow littoral waterbodies that separated the two nations, the Bobian Navy would decline any direct engagements, instead relying on its coastal defenses to strike down the advancing enemy ships just as they get within range of the Bobian fleet.

Bobian forces would possess no actual submarines, and so Technocratic UUVs would be naught but sitting ducks in Bobian waters, torn apart by coastal batteries. Technocratic warships would also suffer a similar fate, with their tightly backed formations and inferior range to Bobian shore batteries leaving them susceptible to receiving first blood. Technocratic attempts to use their USVs as decoys would be doubtful, the massive volume of Reichswehr surface vessels making it virtually impossible to conflate the far smaller USVs with their manned cousins.

Of maritime casualties, the Bobian Navy would be registered much of its frigates as damaged, inoperable, or sunk by the onslaught, though Bobian missile boats and fast attack craft would remain operable for the time being thanks to SummitONE's initial dispersal of its units, and would be more than capable of launching their own anti-ship missiles and suicide boats to wreak havoc on Technocratic carriers, if they weren't already struggling to manage the overwhelming assault of the Bobian Navy's seemingly ceaseless array of mobile coastal batteries and SAM sites.

The Bobian Navy's two fearsome aircraft carriers, which would also similarly survive the onslaught, would play their own role in decimating Technocratic air power and denying air superiority over Bobian skies.

The TKS Seeschlange and TKS Krakenwolf would succeed in launching their payloads, though with the expected thinning of Reichswehr missile fire both on air and sea, Bobian Sky Sabres and Bloodhounds would be more than capable of detecting and striking down the majority of these warheads, with ECM countermeasures jamming, scrambling, or spoofing the rest, though approximately 128 would manage to hit their targets, with roughly half inflicting devasttating casualties to Bobian forces who would register several dozen tanks and armored vehicles lost.

For now, the Bobian Navy would be able to stave off the worst of the damages by remaining at harbor, where ECM countermeasures, decoy drones, and naval mining would be able to stave off the initial attacks.

[b]Operation Tapestry[/b]

While Technocratic forces would be checked in their attempt to fully isolate the British Republic, SummitONE Solutions would not be willing to stand around and wait until they eventually do succeed. With permission from SummitONE's corporate hierarchy, a crack squadron of aircraft would immediately depart from Stormhaven to break the deadlock in the skies. Retrofitted SummitONE Typhoons would be sent as part of the initial inventory together with four Voyagar MRTTs for refueling, all using fourth-generation polymer-based RAM coatings to remain stealth-capable in combat.

Because of the various inherent flaws in the Technocratic aerial strategy, SummitONE aircraft would instead take the long route south, rounding Nairem and the Technocratic Empire's southern exclave before falling on their aircraft at the British Republic proper. Meteor BVRAAMs would be deployed at standoff range to kill any tankers and AWACs before initiating direct engagement with the Reichswehr aircraft, hopefully aiming to force them to disengage from their shock and awe campaign, at which point Typhoon pilots would swap to ASRAAMs and EW jamming pods to successfully dogfight Technocratic aircraft into submission.

No naval assistance would be prepared just yet, though SummitONE's submarine fleet anchored at Kingsmount would be activated, ready and waiting to be deployed at a moment's notice.

Xavier Almstedt, surprised by the sudden turn of events, would immediately add in new offices to the SummitONE Corps of Commissionaires, diverting funds away from SummitONE Technologies to ensure that corporate manpower remains stable and active throughout the operatoin. Back in Bob, Regional Operations Manager Freya Moran would also instruct the Bobian military staff to begin a general mobilization, activating half a million Bobian citizens and readying them for total war against the enemy.

[nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation]
[nation]British Republic of Bob[/nation]
